title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of Intersecting Melodies — Episode8 Warmth That Melts Cold Snow

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Warmth That Melts Cold Snow
meta.Event Outline: Ichika has her eye on the last copy of a CD by an artist who creates Miku songs, but so does a fellow shopper—a girl with long hair. Surprisingly, the girl allows Ichika to take it. Putting the pieces together, Mafuyu realizes the girl in question was Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you both very much today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, allow me to thank you two as well.
It was an incredibly fun learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had fun too. It was nice to talk at length about music with someone for a change.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't get to talk about this at school much either, and seeing you discuss music with others was very interesting, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, would it be possible for us to meet again sometime...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun hearing about your process. I'm still just a novice in terms of writing songs and lyrics, so it'd be nice to hear more of what you have to say...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, I was about to ask you the same thing. It was nice to talk about music with someone outside of my group, so I'd like it if we could meet again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, also, every track on that CD you lent me was very good, so thank you for that as well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About the sheet of paper I left in that bag...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Were those your lyrics, Hoshino? I liked them a lot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Hoshino!
We don't really know anybody else that makes their own music, so we ended up taking a peek...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is this what you were talking about, Ms. Yoisaki? The thing that probably means a lot to Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for looking at it without asking first. However, I thought your lyrics were very straightforward and clearly expressed how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Especially since I can't write lyrics like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to see more if possible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
O-Of course...!
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's this year's first snow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It did get very cold today.
We should all probably head home to make sure we don't catch a cold.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Again, Yoisaki, Asahina, thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We should probably head home too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (In the end, I couldn't find the “answer” I was looking for. Even after feeling so sure that I would as long as I was with Kanade...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm really glad that we met with Hoshino and Ms. Mochizuki today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I want to thank you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mochizuki's the one who did all the planning. I didn't really do anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Ms. Mochizuki did do quite a lot to make this meeting happen.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was able to meet Hoshino today because you were there to tell her more about me. You started everything off.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So in that sense, you're the reason I was able to meet Hoshino at all, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And talking to Hoshino reminded me of something from when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: About how much fun it is to hang out with friends.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My mind's sole focus had become composing a song that's able to save many people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But meeting Hoshino and Ms. Mochizuki today alongside being with you was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I feel this way because you gave me this opportunity to meet her, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad as long as you're happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm this way.
Be careful not to catch a cold, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I won't.
See you later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (All I did was tell Hoshino about her and bring that CD to her.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A simple gesture like that ended up helping Kanade...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's making my chest feel so warm.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But why...?
I don't understand what I'm feeling...)
